title: Final People + Creator Runtime Consolidation 029
hardLaws: 028 Creator Codes and Rooms remain exact-once and save-v11 authoritative.
Recruit Chronicles 025 remains the personal-quest, Hall-scene, mentorship, relationship, Chronicle, and Emergent Legend authority.
People Bonds 026 is the bounded battle-facing payoff layer.
Link Arts remain complete-Forecast-only and preserve underlying member Art legality.
At most one Link Art may trigger per Union per round.
Social scenes cost no operation, never expire, and never force departure.
Creator codes never grant Founders, Kael, Great Covenants, or irreversible canon outcomes.
Runtime generative AI and network dependencies are forbidden.
